manualTestResults.by: Claude (automated browser walkthrough against the real back-end, per user preference)
manualTestResults.notes: Real data: sample file (20 rows) + 3 rows on 2026-04-16; 2 Approved, 1 Rejected. List, sort, paging, page size, all filters incl. whole-day end date and partial case-insensitive search, chips, no-match, incoming link, details (System / Approver User / rejection reason), Back and Back-to-transactions, phone layout and Filters sheet, no Approve/Reject/Export for either role.

items: Status colours: Imported amber (waiting for a decision), Approved green, Rejected red — always with the word. Is amber right for Imported?

On a phone each transaction card shows reference, status, date, amount and Credit/Debit with a Details button; account, description and file name appear only on desktop and the details page. Right set for phones?
The File filter offers only the 50 most recently processed files (older files opened from a link show as "Selected file"). Enough?
On tablets (768–1023px) the filters sit above the list; from 1024px they sit beside it. Acceptable?

"Back to transactions" (not the browser Back button) restores the same filters, sort, page and page size — it relies on the browser tab remembering them; a new tab opened straight onto a transaction links to the default list.
While the list updates after a sort, page or filter change, a small "Updating…" note appears just above it (a blank line is kept there otherwise). Placement acceptable?
On a phone the Filters panel slides up from the bottom (full width) rather than in from the right. OK?
